QuoteInstrumentationSeed_v0.description:
Inner frozen shape — 5 keys per v3 §8 bullet 3.

Instrumentation surface carried INSIDE the quote envelope so late-
refused/rejected/negotiated-to quotes can be reconstructed from the
wire object alone (no dead-reference risk). A separate Northena
Ledger row records outcome/stall/first-lever events as they occur
(Return 4 / stamp_audit sidecar per Standing Disposition
frozen-field-changes-as-new-versions §7.3 note).

first_lever_pulled.description: First axis the buyer moved. None until they move.
first_lever_pulled.title: First Lever Pulled

outcome.description: Buyer disposition at capture-time. `pending` at mint; updates via instrumentation sidecar.
outcome.title: Outcome

price_model_version.description: Belt-and-suspenders with outer envelope. Same value; both places.
price_model_version.title: Price Model Version

shape_ref.description: Reference to shape signature — reach + output + envelope hash.
shape_ref.title: Shape Ref

stall_dimension.description: Which shape axis the negotiation stalled on. None if not stalled.
stall_dimension.title: Stall Dimension

description:
v3 §8 quote envelope — 21st frozen contract.

Freeze posture: FROZEN (Owner ruling Axis 1, Phase 6 Stage A close,
2026-07-04). Buyer-surface integrators + late-refusal-first-class
(§7) + governance-carrying strings (price_model_version, pricing_tier)
all bind on this shape.

Delivery_class Literal (TWO values only per Axis 4 override):
  - `warm_qualified`      → served from qualified estate; fast band.
  - `fresh_extraction`    → requires fresh extraction; queued/priced-higher.
Sub-banding by measured duration arrives post-G2b as REGISTRY bump.

delivery_class.description: §8 bullet 4 two-cost-class discriminator. TWO bands only per Owner ruling Axis 4 (Phase 6 Stage A close, 2026-07-04). Sub-banding post-G2b via registry bump.
delivery_class.title: Delivery Class

delivery_estimate.description: ISO-8601 duration or human string per §8 bullet 4. Loose-as-frozen.
delivery_estimate.title: Delivery Estimate

feasible_and_offerable.description: UI Spec §5.1 'feasible-and-offerable line' — carries as bool at the wire.
feasible_and_offerable.title: Feasible And Offerable

figure.description: Free-form price figure. Loose-as-frozen; narrow at v1 post-G2b.
figure.title: Figure

price_model_version.description: Refs price-model@vN.json version. Constrained-str, NOT Literal (Ruling 5). Pattern: `price-model@v<N>[-<tag>]`.
price_model_version.title: Price Model Version

pricing_tier.description: Refs pricing_tiers.vN.json registry. Constrained-str, NOT Literal (Ruling 5). Extension via registry-bump; unknown tiers rejected by validator at issuance.
pricing_tier.title: Pricing Tier
